name: Freedom for All Creatures
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The filthy Grimtotem clan are capturing faerie dragons, adventurer. Jer'kai and I have no idea what they plan on doing with them, but they're obviously up to no good.

We're not powerful enough to fight our way into the camp and free the captured dragons, but perhaps with your help...

If you're willing, and you have some strong friends, release the creatures from their cage with this key and make sure they escape with their lives. I'll be by your side the entire time. Jer'kai will remain here.
narrative.objectives:
Using the Bamboo Cage Key, free the Sprite Darters from the pen in the Grimtotem camp. At least 6 Sprite Darters and Kindal Moonweaver must survive.

You have 6 minutes before Kindal decides it is time to retreat and you fail the quest.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank Elune, adventurer! You are a great blessing to us and to the darters you saved. Jer'kai and I would never have been able to help the dragons ourselves--your intervention in the Grimtotem's affairs will be remembered.

Speak to Jer'kai now... I have to prepare for our retribution. Just because the faerie dragons are free, it doesn't mean they will remain so. Jer'kai and I will now go on the offensive.
narrative.endText: Save at least 6 Sprite Darters from capture

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 47 to 48, 23,540 XP in all.

quests.name: Freedom for All Creatures
quests.objectiveText: Using the Bamboo Cage Key, free the Sprite Darters from the pen in the Grimtotem camp.

quests.name: Doling Justice
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Grimtotem Naturalists, 10 Grimtotem Raiders, and 6 Grimtotem Shamans before returning to Jer'kai Moonweaver in Feralas.

quests.name: Doling Justice
quests.objectiveText: Take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.

quests.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: A Short Incubation
quests.objectiveText: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: The Newest Member of the Family
quests.objectiveText: Take your Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.

quests.name: Food for Baby
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

quests.name: Becoming a Parent
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.
